owner_creation.analysis: ifiles: The private c_int owns the count of linked nodes, initially zero and adjusted by link_ifile/unlink_ifile; it owns no node memory itself.
owner_creation.invariant: File count is metadata, not a resource owner.
limitations: Only this membership counter is reviewed; a count match does not prove circular-list, held-handle or descriptor correctness.

aliases_escapes.analysis: ifiles: nifile copies the count to callers; no address escapes, but count accuracy depends on raw list updates completing together.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A copied count cannot establish node lifetime.
limitations: Only this membership counter is reviewed; a count match does not prove circular-list, held-handle or descriptor correctness.

callback_targets.analysis: ifiles: There is no callback stored in this integer; surrounding mark/disposal calls belong to the node operations that adjust it.
callback_targets.invariant: Count metadata cannot register callback ownership.
limitations: Only this membership counter is reviewed; a count match does not prove circular-list, held-handle or descriptor correctness.

invalidation.analysis: ifiles: Deleting a node decrements the value without retiring any caller-held node pointer; count changes cannot be used as generation checks.
invalidation.invariant: Count decrements do not invalidate external aliases safely.
limitations: Only this membership counter is reviewed; a count match does not prove circular-list, held-handle or descriptor correctness.

mutation_commit.analysis: ifiles: Count increment/decrement happens after link writes and uses unchecked c_int arithmetic, with no transactional rollback on interrupted mutation.
mutation_commit.invariant: Count and list membership lack a joint commit guard.
limitations: Only this membership counter is reviewed; a count match does not prove circular-list, held-handle or descriptor correctness.

release_pair.analysis: ifiles: This scalar is not freed; freeing a node only logically removes one count contribution and must not release the count object.
release_pair.invariant: Static count storage survives every node deletion.
limitations: Only this membership counter is reviewed; a count match does not prove circular-list, held-handle or descriptor correctness.

error_cleanup.analysis: ifiles: No overflow/error policy protects the signed count or restores it after partial list mutation; this limitation belongs to the existing raw-core finding.
error_cleanup.invariant: Count arithmetic has no proved upper-bound contract here.
limitations: Only this membership counter is reviewed; a count match does not prove circular-list, held-handle or descriptor correctness.

signals_handoff.analysis: ifiles: The counter is a mutable static rather than atomic main-loop-owned state; interrupted traversal or cleanup has no synchronization contract.
limitations: Only this membership counter is reviewed; a count match does not prove circular-list, held-handle or descriptor correctness.
